_comment: Shape stage 2 must emit for stage 3 to consume. Element type keys are load-bearing: each STRIDE skill iterates only the element types its letter applies to, so unlabelled boxes degrade the analysis into generic advice. 'mermaid' is optional; 'dfd' is not. 'file_hints' are optional but sharply improve evidence quality.

use_cases.name: Registered customer signs in with email and password
use_cases.description: A customer submits credentials to the login endpoint. The application verifies them against the user store and issues a signed token used by every subsequent authenticated request.

processes.name: Login Handler
processes.description: Validates credentials and issues a token

use_cases.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  C[Customer]:::ext -->|credentials| L[Login Handler]
  L -->|lookup| U[(User Table)]
  L --> T[Token Issuer]
  T -->|JWT| C

use_cases.name: Customer resets a forgotten password
use_cases.description: A customer requests a reset, receives a token out of band, and submits it with a new password to replace the stored credential.
